title: Event ID 4104 — Decoded PowerShell script block for the encoded launch

callouts.explanation: This is the plaintext script after PowerShell's own engine base64-decoded the -enc argument — the obfuscation that defeats a raw command-line string match does not survive this hop, which is the specific claim this figure supports.
4104 only exists in this channel if script block logging was explicitly enabled via GPO; without that setting this event never fires and the field above never appears in any log.
Correlates this decoded block back to the originating process and, when a script is split across multiple 4104 events, ties fragments together via MessageNumber/MessageTotal.

note: Illustrative/conceptual field breakdown of what a 4104 entry would contain for this scenario; not a captured screenshot or product interface, and not generated from a real lab run.
